title: Gift Cards & Store Credit Status Housekeeping and Bearer Card Registration
content:
A Gift Cards & Store Credit instrument's status follows its balance. It moves to depleted when the balance reaches 0.00, and it closes once its type's depleted retention period in calendar days has passed after its last transaction, if nothing has come back to it.

## Status rules

1. **Depletion.** The instrument moves to depleted when its balance reaches 0.00.
2. **Closing after retention.** A depleted instrument closes the type's depleted retention period in calendar days after its last transaction, if nothing has come back to it.
3. **Voiding before dispatch.** A plastic Marlowe & Finch Gift Card or a Bonus Gift Card still in pending activation is voided when the order line or promotion that created it is cancelled before dispatch.

## Registration of bearer cards

A bearer card (a type that allows registration) is registered to the profile of a verified customer who states its full card number and PIN. Registration makes that customer the holder of record, is possible only while the card is active, and cannot be undone by the previous holder. The card number and PIN come from the customer; whether the card is active is read from the card's record. Account-bound instruments are never registered to another customer.

| Card | Status | Verified customer states full card number and PIN | Registered? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | Active | Yes | Yes; the customer becomes holder of record |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Locked | Yes | No — only while active |
| Bonus Gift Card | Active | Card number only, no PIN | No |
| Return Store Credit | Active | (no card number exists) | No — account-bound |

## Retention dates (hypothetical instruments)

| Instrument | Last transaction | Depleted retention | Closes on, if nothing comes back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note, depleted | 10 January | 30 days | 9 February |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card, depleted | 1 March 2025 | 365 days | 1 March 2026 |
